description: This file defines a class for handling Azure-specific configurations and behaviors for the GPT-5 model family within the litellm library, including model identification, parameter mapping, and request transformation.

classes.name: AzureOpenAIGPT5Config
classes.description: Azure-specific configuration class for GPT-5 models, handling model identification, parameter mapping, and request transformation.

methods.name: is_model_gpt_5_model
methods.description: Checks if a given model string refers to a GPT-5 variant, based on presence of 'gpt-5' or 'gpt5_series/' prefix.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Retrieves supported OpenAI parameters for the specified model.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps and validates OpenAI parameters, handling special cases for reasoning effort and model version.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Transforms the request by adjusting the model string and calling the superclass method.
